- Booth staffing target: 3 full shifts per day (AM, Mid, PM); 1 floater per day for demos
- Arrival window: June 8 (preferred) — vendor load-in on the 8th afternoon
- Departure: June 11 evening or 12th morning for those on late shifts

Marissa: can you attach the latest proposed shift matrix?
Dev: if TravelOps ends up booking, confirm whether we should use company card or traveler-pay/concur route.
Arianna: any updates to exhibitor badge pickup or exhibitor lounge hours we should know?

- Day lead: Marissa Cole (onsite manager)
- Demo lead: Dev Patel
- AM shift Fri-Sat: Stephanie Nguyen

Please reply with: 1) final availabilities, 2) booking preference (company vs traveler), 3) any dietary or hotel requirements.

- Exhibitor hotel block is open through May 18; Hilton downtown is the primary hotel (block code: TS26RED)
- Badge pick-up: June 8, 3pm-7pm at West Hall; on-site registration opens at 7am on June 9
- Exhibitor lounge hours: Jun 9: 7:30-10:00, Jun 10: 7:30-10:00, Jun 11: 7:30-9:00

Quick update after checking flights and vendor options:
- Delta has one nonstop arriving June 8 at 10:15 (preferred), otherwise one connection adds 3h layover.
- TravelOps confirmed they can book on the company card but need final roster + traveler DOBs/passport name by May 18.
- If we go traveler-pay (Concur), the itinerary link will differ and cost center allocation must be included at booking.

I've uploaded a live roster (view/edit): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1TechSummitRoster — please add passenger names, seat prefs, and any special requests.

2) Booking route: TravelOps to book on company card. Dev, please confirm cost center code so they can finish.
